title: AISIX AI Gateway
description: Monitor AISIX AI Gateway request rates, LLM model latency, token consumption, cache performance, and policy guardrails.

metrics.name: aisix_llm_requests_total
metrics.description: Total number of LLM requests processed by AISIX Gateway

metrics.name: aisix_requests_in_flight
metrics.description: Current number of in-flight LLM requests

metrics.name: aisix_config_reload_last_success_timestamp_seconds
metrics.description: Timestamp of the last successful configuration reload

metrics.name: aisix_config_resources_rejected_total
metrics.description: Total number of rejected or incompatible configuration resources

metrics.name: aisix_request_e2e_latency_seconds
metrics.description: End-to-end latency distribution of LLM requests

metrics.name: aisix_request_ttft_seconds
metrics.description: Time to first token (TTFT) latency for streaming requests

metrics.name: aisix_token_usage_total
metrics.description: Total input and output token consumption across models

metrics.name: aisix_cache_outcomes_total
metrics.description: Prompt cache outcomes (hits, semantic hits, misses, bypasses)

metrics.name: aisix_rate_limit_rejections_total
metrics.description: Rejections due to rate limiting policy enforcement

metrics.name: aisix_upstream_attempts_total
metrics.description: Upstream deployment attempt count grouped by model and outcome

metrics.name: aisix_fallback_attempts_total
metrics.description: Fallback attempt outcomes across upstream deployment targets

metrics.name: aisix_target_health_status
metrics.description: Health state of upstream model deployment targets (1 = healthy, 0 = unhealthy)

metrics.name: aisix_usage_event_dropped_total
metrics.description: Number of dropped usage events by reason
